en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3003 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Imam (as)
regarding a man who left Muzdalifah (Jam') for Mina but encountered an issue and did not stone the Jamarat until the sun had set.
Imam (as) said: "He should perform the stoning twice the next morning: once early in the morning for the previous day and again at the time of noon for the current day."
